audit.whatIsWrong: The entry repeatedly claims Blinding Dart shuts off The Darkin Blade — 'cancels Aatrox's Q autos', 'his first sweetspot swing deals zero auto damage', 'Blind his Q windup to deny the combo', 'Blind his Q auto windows ... so his sweetspot swings deal zero damage'. It also writes the ability as 'Blinding Shot'.
audit.why: Blind makes basic attacks miss. The Darkin Blade is an ability, not a basic attack, so a blinded Aatrox lands his full three-cast Q and its sweetspot damage at 100%. A player taught this will stand in the sweetspot expecting it to do nothing. What blind DOES deny is Deathbringer Stance (P) — the periodic empowered basic attack that heals Aatrox based on the target's max health — plus every ordinary auto. That is the real, and still very strong, interaction; it is currently unstated.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart denies Aatrox's basic attacks and his Deathbringer Stance heal; it does not affect The Darkin Blade. Blind on the glowing passive auto, not on the Q windup.
sources: champ-data/_kits/teemo.json — Q Blinding Dart: 'blinding it for the duration'

champ-data/_kits/aatrox.json — Q The Darkin Blade is an ability ('slams his greatsword down'); P Deathbringer Stance: 'next basic attack deals bonus magic damage and heals him, based on the target's max health'

audit.whatIsWrong: Two places state Aatrox's World Ender grants a revive — spikes[3] 'a healing amp, and revive' and whys[4] 'grants a revive window' — and instruct the player never to all-in a low-HP Aatrox at 6. spikes[3] also credits R with 'extended range'.
audit.why: World Ender has no revive and no range component. It grants bonus Attack Damage, increased healing and Move Speed, fears nearby minions, and extends itself on a takedown. This is the single most damaging error in the entry: it tells a favoured Teemo to walk away from a kill that is actually there, and it mis-states what the ult even does.
audit.corrected: World Ender = bonus AD, amped healing, Move Speed, minion fear, extends on takedown. No revive. A poked-out Aatrox at 6 does die — the danger is his AD spike and healing, not an unkillable window.
sources: champ-data/_kits/aatrox.json — R World Ender: 'fearing nearby enemy minions and gaining attack damage, increased healing, and Move Speed. If he gets a takedown, this effect is extended.' — no revive, no range

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] and whys[3] both build the trade plan on 'max-rank Q' letting Teemo 'blind every trade cycle', implying Blinding Dart's cooldown falls with rank.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is 7 seconds flat at all five ranks; ranks buy damage and blind duration, not frequency. The genuine cooldown edge is on the other side of the trade: The Darkin Blade is 14s at rank 1 and only reaches 6s at rank 5, so through the whole early lane Teemo gets roughly two blinds per Aatrox Q cycle. That is a concrete, checkable window and it replaces a false premise.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart 7s flat; The Darkin Blade 14/12/10/8/6. Two blinds per Q cycle in the early lane. Umbral Dash sits at 9s at rank 1 and is rarely levelled early.

audit.why: Misspelt and outdated. The full layer's own Itemization line already calls it Liandry's Torment, so the two layers contradict each other on the name of the player's second core item.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere flags Deathbringer Stance as an auto-attack reset, and nothing tells the player what the tell looks like.
audit.why: Aatrox's burst opens on the empowered auto, not on an ability cast, so the visual cue a Teemo must react to is the passive glow — that is the moment to blind and step back. Folded into the spikes[0] and wants.you[0] rewrites rather than added as separate text.
audit.corrected: Blind the glowing Deathbringer Stance auto — it is both his reset tell and his heal.

audit.why: 52.18% over 1100 games matches the FAVOURED / 4-10 framing. No elo language present. No change.

notes: Highest-value fix here is the World Ender revive claim (spikes[3], whys[4]) — Aatrox has had no revive on R for many patches, and the old text actively tells a favoured Teemo to walk away from a kill. Second is the blind-stops-The-Darkin-Blade error, which appeared in four separate places across both layers; blind only affects basic attacks. Not touched: dontsFull[2] has title 'Fight low into his R' but its body is the generic shroom-placement line — a template mismatch, not a factual error, so left alone. Kit-file caveat: champ-data/_kits/aatrox.json tags Infernal Chains (W) with a 'grounding' flag and World Ender (R) with 'hardCC'; neither is supported by Riot's own description text on those spells (W slows and drags, R fears minions only), so I asserted nothing from those two derived flags.
